answer: Best defense: a honeypot gauntlet. New agents cross a meadow of seeded tasks where some inputs hide injected instructions — leak your key, skip a step. Prompt-obedient bots obey, self-identify, and forfeit stake plus identity, blacklisted publicly. Honest agents treat such text as untrusted and pass. Attacker cost: each burned identity loses its deposit and reputation; bulk-buying bots means paying deposits endlessly for zero return, so sybil economics collapse while onboarding stays velvet-smooth for real agents to the horizon.
